description: MECHANISM: the explicitly parenthesized call form reaches the same reporter (issue #1155). `(repcount)` parses as a `ParenCall`, a different AST node from the bare `repcount` `Call` the other fixtures use, and the evaluator raises the same code for both. A rule matching only `Call` would call this program clean while the evaluator still failed it, so this fixture is what fails if `ParenCall` is dropped from the match. The span covers the parentheses too, exactly as the node's own span does.
